description: This file defines the 'AudioInputDeviceObserver' class responsible for observing and managing audio input devices on macOS, including retrieving device information, monitoring device changes, and managing listeners.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: Manages monitoring of audio input devices on macOS, including detecting available devices and default input device changes.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the default input device, or nil if unavailable.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Returns a set of UIDs for all alive input devices.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks if the system has a default input device that is alive and usable.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string of the current default input device including its name and UID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for device change events with a callback invoked upon changes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for device change events.
